assetBrief:
SUBJECT: segments as measurable pieces of lines — a stroke between draggable endpoints A and B on a board; a ruler below updates the length live; a measure tape can snap onto the stroke.

GEOMETRY: A flat board with a straight stroke between two solid endpoint dots labeled A and B. Both endpoints are draggable; the stroke stretches, shrinks, and slides accordingly. A small ruler sits along the bottom edge and a live reading label above shows the length. A 'measure' button snaps a tape line onto the stroke and reads out the exact length in units.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) segment stroke; (3) endpoints A and B; (4) ruler + reading label.

CAMERA: three-quarter from above-front, frames board and ruler; labels legible. Budget 4-8k triangles. Named nodes: Board, SegmentStroke, Endpoint_A, Endpoint_B, Ruler, ReadingLabel, MeasureTape. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
